title: HyRoS: code and results for chronological, cross-corpus and evasion stress tests of lightweight spam filters
description: Code, split indices and result files for the study "Beyond Near-Perfect Accuracy: Chronological, Cross-Corpus and Evasion Stress Tests of Lightweight Spam Filters". Version 2.0.0 adds the analyses of the revised manuscript. See README.md for data sources and reproduction steps.
